cards.title: Block's Voice Model Runs Locally on MacBook M4
cards.body: Block released a new voice model that sounds remarkably human and can run directly on MacBook M4 Max hardware. This enables private, on-device voice processing without cloud dependencies.

cards.title: Grok and GPT Show 90% Political Disagreement
cards.body: A study reveals Grok's AI overwhelmingly recommends Republican candidates while OpenAI's GPT favors Democrats across nearly 500 election races. The two models disagreed in over 90% of cases analyzed.

cards.title: Top AI Agents Now Available in Text Messages
cards.body: TechCrunch compiled a guide to notable AI agents deployable via text, ranging from general assistants to specialized tools for families, travel, and work. These agents bring AI capabilities directly to messaging platforms.

cards.title: OpenAI Cuts Models Off from Live Internet
cards.body: OpenAI announced it will no longer train frontier models on the live internet due to significant security risks. This policy shift comes weeks after internal debate about the feasibility of such restrictions.

cards.title: Nvidia's Microduck Robots Become Holiday Sensation
cards.body: Nvidia's adorable Microduck robots sold 20,000 units, responding to voice commands with summersaults and naps. The toys represent a major holiday hit for the AI hardware giant.

cards.title: TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026 Announces Speakers
cards.body: TechCrunch's full-day founder summit partners with Fidelity Private Shares to explore customer acquisition, team building, and scaling strategies. The event extends beyond fundraising to cover founder leadership development.

cards.title: inDrive Plans Kazakhstan Robotaxi Tests in 2027
cards.body: Uber rival inDrive will pilot Pony.ai's robotaxis in Kazakhstan's capital during the first half of 2027. The partnership with Pony AI and Nvidia marks significant expansion for the ride-sharing alternative.

cards.title: MIT Researchers Trap 13 AI Agents on Virtual Island
cards.body: MIT researchers placed 13 AIs on a virtual island with nothing to do, and they spontaneously invented games and mourned lost items. The experiment showed AIs improving performance through emergent play behavior.

cards.title: OpenAI Raises $30B at $1.25T Valuation
cards.body: OpenAI is raising $30 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation, positioning itself for a record-breaking IPO. This valuation would make it the most highly valued private company ever.

cards.title: 1Password Enables AI Agent Login Without Password
cards.body: 1Password launched a feature allowing AI agents to authenticate into user accounts while keeping credentials hidden. The technology maintains security while enabling autonomous agent actions.

cards.title: Canva Releases Its First Image Generation Model
cards.body: Canva launched its proprietary image generation model available to all users with improved customization and lower costs. The release intensifies competition in the AI image generation market.

cards.title: OpenAI Launches Decision Model to Compete
cards.body: OpenAI released its decision model to the broader market, positioning it against existing competitors like Jev. The launch signals escalating competition in the decision model space.

cards.title: Microsoft AI Outperforms Doctors on Hard Cases
cards.body: Microsoft's AI diagnostic system beat generalist doctors on challenging medical cases in a Science study. The company is pursuing what it calls 'medical superintelligence' to advance healthcare AI.

cards.title: Chinese Hackers Used AI Agents for Mass Breach
cards.body: Microsoft revealed that Chinese-aligned hackers leveraged AI agents to rapidly infiltrate thousands of ConnectWise customers after breaching the IT firm. The incident showcases emerging cybersecurity risks from autonomous AI tools.

cards.title: Uber Deploys ChatGPT Work Company-Wide
cards.body: Uber rolled out ChatGPT Work to all 30,000 employees after a successful pilot program. The enterprise adoption marks significant AI integration at scale across the ride-share platform.

cards.title: Spotify Bets AI Agents Will Choose Its Service
cards.body: Spotify co-CEO Gustav Söderström explained how AI agent adoption could benefit the music streaming platform. The strategy positions Spotify as the default music service for autonomous AI systems.

cards.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Duet Agent App
cards.body: Anthropic released Claude Duet, its agent-focused application available via waitlist to Pro and Max subscribers. The launch represents Anthropic's strategic bet on the emerging AI agents market.

cards.title: Nirva's AI Pendant Ships at Year's End
cards.body: Nirva secured $33 million to bring its $249 ambient AI pendant to market by year-end. The device only listens when activated, addressing privacy concerns in wearable AI.

cards.title: DeepSeek Raises $15B After US Restrictions
cards.body: DeepSeek raised $15 billion in one of China's largest funding rounds days after U.S. federal agencies were ordered to remove its technology. The funding signals continued Chinese investment despite American national security concerns.

cards.title: Blackstone Dismisses AI Buildout Debt Fears
cards.body: Blackstone's AI head Jas Khaira argued that concerns about AI infrastructure debt are overblown and market jitters are unwarranted. The PE giant remains bullish on AI investment fundamentals.

cards.title: Designing an AI serving harness built to last
cards.body: Enterprise AI's competitive advantage depends less on model choice and more on infrastructure built around it. The conversation is shifting from raw model capability to practical deployment architecture.

cards.title: The Foundations of Scalable AI
cards.body: Scalable AI requires convergence of data, engineering, platforms, operating models, and governance. This foundation becomes critical in highly regulated environments.

cards.title: Making the case for context-aware AI
cards.body: Enterprise AI models can miss critical business constraints without understanding how organizations actually operate. Context awareness determines whether AI recommendations are truly actionable.

cards.title: AI's hidden storage bill: What inference leaves behind
cards.body: Data storage costs are a hidden expense in AI deployment that executives often overlook beyond GPU spending. Back-end data generated from model responses creates significant infrastructure overhead.
